title: Ukraine conducts large-scale drone strikes on Russia, killing 4 and wounding 12 others
summary: One of Ukraine's largest drone strikes on Russia killed at least four people, including three near Moscow, and wounded a dozen others, local authorities said Sunday.
contentText:
One of Ukraine's largest drone strikes on Russia killed at least four people, including three near Moscow, and wounded a dozen others, local authorities said Sunday.

(Image credit: Andrei Vorobyev/Moscow Region Governor Andrei Vo)
